name: web-performance
description: Use this skill when optimising runtime performance, Core Web Vitals, bundle size, or asset loading for Vue/Vite projects — including GitHub Pages deployments. Covers LCP, CLS, INP, Vue reactivity cost, code splitting, images, fonts, and measurement. Distinct from vite-patterns (build config) and accessibility (which covers prefers-reduced-motion).
when: When optimising Core Web Vitals, bundle size, or asset loading for Vue/Vite/GitHub Pages projects
do-not-use-when: Configuring the Vite build — use vite-patterns
Writing animation or transition code — check accessibility for reduced-motion first
